admission.justification: The rule is guarded end to end by the new module's grouped-deletion, reworded-group, single-source, overview and author-supplied-sources cases, whose grouped proof runs the leaf's own worklist into the writer and back. Leaving it unstated costs a whole group: L56's two deleted c-05 skill files carry nine identical copies each, so their card items could not be answered at all and its memory check kept four findings.

applicability: Every onboarding-trace row the file writer authors for a card subject -- a file-level card or a route overview -- in a converted memory worktree.
conditions: An onboarding_trace item's valid source list remains authoritative; every trace subject excludes matching unexplained groups even when that trace metadata is unusable.

Without a trace item, collect the sorted union of string member paths from sourceBlobs of matching uncovered unexplained_hunk and unexplained_file items with mapped facts, onboardingTrace and sourceBlobs.
Resolve every selected path from the candidate code snapshot, recording absent for a missing path; never copy worklist blob values into row history.
When no usable selected source entry exists, including a trace with unusable metadata that suppresses groups, a file subject binds its own path and an overview keeps its no-worklist-item refusal.
An item naming only one path retains one-source binding.
exclusions: Covered unexplained items, other item kinds and other subjects contribute no member paths; malformed facts or member paths contribute no group.
The gate, grouping producer, authoring-row owner and refusal of an author-supplied sources field are unchanged.
Other row kinds do not take their sources through this selection.
A row answering its item is not whole-suite, installed-host, serving-build or acceptance evidence.
statement: For each onboarding subject, the knowledge writer binds its row to the source paths selected by the trace-item precedence and matching uncovered-group rules, with each blob read from the candidate.
